scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof by precise second-positive-fiber geometry; complete finite-depth query-tree witnesses and exact independent recurrences; previous static VC-dimension results are cited, not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Only open neighborhoods of rank-two Johnson graphs J(n,2), n>=2. Induced-subgraph bound is uniform rather than exact. No wider-rank formula or claim of exhaustive historical priority.
title: Exact online shattering dimensions of triangular-graph neighborhoods
